reading.title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Education
reading.passage: Artificial intelligence is transforming the education sector by personalizing learning experiences and automating administrative tasks. AI-powered platforms can analyze student performance data and adapt content to individual learning styles, helping learners progress at their own pace. Furthermore, intelligent tutoring systems provide immediate feedback and support, reducing the burden on teachers. However, concerns about data privacy and the digital divide remain significant challenges that educators must address when implementing AI technologies in classrooms.

questions.q: According to the passage, how does AI help students?
options: By personalizing learning and providing immediate feedback
By eliminating the need for administrative staff
By reducing the cost of textbooks
questions.explanation: 지문에서 AI가 학생의 학습 스타일에 맞춰 콘텐츠를 조정하고 즉시 피드백을 제공한다고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What challenges are mentioned regarding AI in education?
questions.explanation: 지문의 마지막 문장에서 데이터 개인정보 보호와 디지털 격차가 AI 도입 시 해결해야 할 과제라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What do intelligent tutoring systems do?
options: Provide immediate feedback and support to students
questions.explanation: 지문에서 지능형 튜터링 시스템이 즉시 피드백과 지원을 제공한다고 설명되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Technology has made communication easier but reduced the quality of human relationships'? Provide reasons and examples.

structure.intro: 도입부: 찬성/반대 입장을 명확히 표현하고 주요 논거를 간단히 제시하기 (2-3문장)
structure.body1: 본론1: 첫 번째 주장 제시 및 구체적 사례/근거 제공 (3-4문장)
structure.body2: 본론2: 두 번째 주장 제시 및 반론에 대한 반박 또는 추가 근거 (3-4문장)
structure.conclusion: 결론: 주장을 재강조하고 광범위한 의미 제시 (2-3문장)

useful_phrases: In conclusion, while technology offers conveniences...
Some might argue that..., but I believe...

speaking.prompt: Some people believe that remote work is more productive than office work. Others disagree. Which perspective do you agree with? Explain your choice with reasons and examples.
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I believe that remote work...
One reason is that remote workers can...
For example, many employees have found...
However, some people argue that..., yet I think...
In summary, I prefer [remote/office work] because...
sample_points: 원격근무의 이점: 통근 시간 절감으로 생산성 향상, 방해 요소 감소, 업무 유연성 증대. 예를 들어, 많은 직원이 집에서 더 집중력 있게 일할 수 있다고 보고함
사무실 근무의 이점: 팀 협업 강화, 즉각적인 소통 가능, 회사 문화 형성. 예를 들어, 복잡한 프로젝트는 대면 회의에서 더 효과적으로 진행됨

listening.title: Professor's Lecture on Climate Change and Agriculture
listening.script: Good morning, everyone. Today I want to discuss how climate change is affecting global agriculture. As temperatures rise and weather patterns become more unpredictable, farmers around the world face significant challenges. For instance, droughts in Africa are reducing crop yields dramatically, while flooding in Southeast Asia destroys entire plantations. Additionally, changing seasons affect the timing of planting and harvesting, which has been traditionally guided by seasonal patterns. Many agricultural experts now recommend adopting drought-resistant crop varieties and implementing advanced irrigation systems. Furthermore, governments and international organizations are investing in research to develop crops that can withstand extreme weather conditions. It's crucial that we take action soon, as agriculture feeds billions of people worldwide. Without these adaptations, food security will become an even greater global concern in the coming decades.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the lecture?
questions.explanation: 강의자가 기후 변화가 전 세계 농업에 미치는 영향에 대해 설명하고 있으므로, 이것이 주요 주제입니다.

questions.q: According to the professor, what are two specific problems caused by climate change?
options: Droughts in Africa and flooding in Southeast Asia
questions.explanation: 교수는 아프리카의 가뭄과 동남아시아의 홍수를 기후 변화로 인한 구체적인 문제로 언급했습니다.

questions.q: What solutions does the professor suggest?
options: Drought-resistant crops and advanced irrigation systems
Move all farms to developed countries
questions.explanation: 교수는 가뭄에 견디는 작물 품종 채택과 고급 관개 시스템 도입을 권장 해결책으로 제시했습니다.
